grade_checkpoints.format: desktop/mobile on the audit letter scale
grade_checkpoints.confidence: function now H, later M to L on mobile; UX L; performance lab H field L; data accuracy L; A+ needs non-author evidence (D-EVIDENCE)

path_definitions.S: survival: R0 plus the criticals that block basic use (plan for 10-12 h/week)
path_definitions.L: legacy A-line: no critical defect, CWV green, Tier 1 usable on phones, Historian P1, plus data, rights, legal, time, trust, operations on the frozen app and static layer
path_definitions.A: grade-A path: L plus the rebuild core to cutover (needs a second contributor or 30+ h/week)
path_definitions.F: full A+: Tier 1 at A+, Tier 2 at A, proof; Labs and stretch items are in P7 or deferred
